Mumbai ice cream shop shut after hygiene violations

A popular ice cream parlour in Churchgate, Mumbai, has been shut down by officials following a raid that found rats and serious hygiene lapses. The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) had taken action against the establishment due to expired products and unsanitary conditions. This incident highlights the importance of food safety and regulatory oversight in the city's eateries.
